item.title: Hundreds of foreign runners to descend upon North Korea for Pyongyang marathon
item.description: North Korea is set to welcome international visitors for its premier international marathon for the second straight year, despite ongoing tourism restrictions barring many foreigners, according to one of the event’s partners.
